Senior Data Analyst

About Us
ScaleFlow is a fast-growing B2B analytics startup building decision tools for mid-market logistics companies. We turn messy operational data into clear, actionable dashboards that help customers cut costs and improve on-time delivery. Small, scrappy team; high ownership.

What you'll do
- Own end-to-end data analysis projects: gather requirements, design queries, build dashboards, and communicate insights to product and customer teams.
- Design and maintain interactive Tableau dashboards that surface KPIs and driver analyses for operations and finance.
- Write and optimize SQL queries against large transactional datasets to support reporting and ad-hoc investigations.
- Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define metrics, ensure data quality, and implement instrumentation.
- Mentor junior analysts, run regular reviews of dashboards, and help shape our analytics best practices.

What we need (mandatory)
- SQL
- Tableau
- 5+ years

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- Python
- Looker

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Pune, 3 days a week in the office.
